anxietyFree.title: Anxiety-Free Space
anxietyFree.description: A warm, patient AI companion that feels human, ensuring your child loves returning every day.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Answers to common questions about our 5-minute daily language university.

q1.question: How long is a daily session?
q1.answer: Each mission is strictly 5 minutes. This creates a fast-paced cognitive threshold that prevents burnout and keeps your child excited for the next day.

q2.question: Does my child need to know how to read?
q2.answer: Not at all. The entire ecosystem is voice-based conversational roleplay. They simply listen and speak to their AI companion.

DemoIntro.title: Before we begin
DemoIntro.subtitle: This demo lets your child experience our calm, voice-based learning environment. Here is what to expect.
DemoIntro.f1Desc: No screen staring. Just a calm voice conversation. Mistakes are encouraged as part of learning.
DemoIntro.f2Desc: The demo takes about 2 minutes. We will gently guide them through a simple introduction.
DemoIntro.disclaimer: No credit card required for demo. We require an account to prevent spam.

DemoSession.welcome: Welcome! I see you want to learn. That's amazing. Let's begin our first lesson.
DemoSession.patternDrop: Here at uNiMONDAY, I'm Monday, and my friends and I say 'Good morning' to each other in the morning. Let's try together. When I say 'Good morning', you answer 'Good morning to you too.' Ready? Good morning!
DemoSession.successResponse: Excellent job! You sounded very natural. Now, what is your favorite color?
DemoSession.completeDesc: They did a fantastic job communicating.
